assertions.name: cyclic_order3_identity
assertions.source: C³ prefactors multiply to 1, returns I_Δ(m,e)

description: Pins the full S₃ triality of the DGG tetrahedron index I_Δ(m,e)(q) empirically (no guessed convention). ℤ/3 generator: I_Δ(m,e)=(-q^½)^m·I_Δ(-e-m,m) (order-3, prefactors→1); ℤ/2 generator: I_Δ(m,e)=I_Δ(-e,-m) (no prefactor). Both green on the full (m,e)∈[-3,3]² grid incl. negative e, cross-checked at two q. Corrects the #3805 test (-q^?)^e — the prefactor depends on m, not e — unblocking the 4₁ two-tetrahedron gluing (G3 route). Audit-only; no wiring.
